statement: SYN-IDS-v1 is COMPLETELY SYNTHETIC despite its name: it is generated with scikit-learn make_classification, is not real intrusion-detection data, contains no patient data and no personal data. CIC-IDS-2017 was not available and is not used.
not_for: any claim about real intrusion detection or real patients
numerical comparison with published CIC-IDS-2017 results
